name: JPEG still-image compression standard
description: A standard family for coding and compressing continuous-tone still images.

impact.note: Most photographs seen on phones and the web use it; it made image storage and exchange cheaper rather than new, with a few successor formats.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: CCITT/ITU-T T.81 specified JPEG still-image coding.

evidence.supports: Standards group dates ITU-T T.81 to 1992 and ISO/IEC 10918-1 to 1994.
ITU indexes the September 1992 recommendation and coding modes.

events.caveats: Specification is not a count of deployed implementations.
